milestone: Budgeted request-local native Engram host history
status: qualified host component; full goal remains active

implementation.owner: Optional BnSessionNativeHistory allocation owned by BnSessionBackendState. Model map remains shared and immutable. No default-path execution admission.
implementation.allocation: One budgeted allocation contains metadata, context-capacity compressed history, staged mapped prefix/window and an owned raw-token batch. Stage/view/commit/abort/rewind allocate nothing.
implementation.staging: Full raw-ID validation before writes; stage copies input without changing committed history, raw session history or position. All layers can consume the same read-only view. Missing context uses model-derived compressed padding, never zero/raw padding by assumption.
implementation.finalization: Ticket checks session owner, mapped window, epoch, shape and position. Commit copies staged raw/mapped history and advances host position. Abort discards staged host state. Reset cancels pending state, clears history after GPU resource release and invalidates tickets; free releases history after backend resources. Epoch never wraps.
implementation.rewind: Bookkeeping only, after caller has restored backend compute state and session position. Rejects active transactions, forward extension and position mismatch; preserves prefix and clears discarded suffix. No KV, recurrent or GPU state restoration is implemented by this helper.
implementation.caller_contract: Caller serializes the session, keeps model immutable/alive, consumes views before finalization, gates commit on successful WHOLE-model completion and handles failed queued work through backend reset/poison policy. View output must be disjoint from session/model storage.

memory.scope: Exact history allocation including its metadata and arrays. Existing session/backend owner metadata, raw history, logits, arena, model token map, caches, GPU storage and allocator overhead are separate.

independent_reference.source: Unchanged original raw-token and mapped-history capture in /tmp/bitnet-goal-native-engram/reference-final; immutable native vocabulary/map evidence inherited from parent.
independent_reference.procedure: Actual model map is built natively. Each source sequence runs through budgeted session staging, abort/retry, stale-ticket rejection and commit for each chunk size, then midpoint history rewind/replay after simulated backend restoration. Every staged prefix/window and committed raw ID is checked against original data. Generated histories feed existing hash and CUDA lookup probes.

validation.unit_cases: Mapped padding differs from raw ID; budget/reinitialization rejection; late invalid IDs; stale and foreign tickets; borrowed-window input alias; input lifetime; chunk partitioning; pending reset; session isolation; simulated rewind; full1048576-token context fill and overflow rejection.
validation.allocation_failure: Denied history constructor allocation leaves the session unprepared; retry succeeds. Budget-1 rejects with zero linked hot heap calls.
validation.sanitizers: ASAN/UBSAN instrument new C session/history paths. CUDA memcheck reports zero errors and zero leaked allocations; initcheck passes. Racecheck is limited to unchanged bounded row decoder. Legacy moe_cpu_kernels and CUDA translation units use normal builds.
validation.qwen27: Fresh strict CUDA match192/192 sampled IDs, first8/8, zero count mismatches, words147/147.
validation.integrity: Source/reference/probe/binary hashes audited at each gate; four user binaries preserved. No production/probe changes after freeze.

not_claimed: Full-model transaction completion gate or failure rollback
Actual backend KV/recurrent/GPU rewind or resumed native full-model execution
vLLM parity or new AVX2/AVX512/NEON/Metal execution coverage
